name: @pipeworx/mcp-global-forest-watch

tools.name: gfw_datasets
tools.description: List or keyword-search the Global Forest Watch Data API catalogue — the WRI/UMD datasets behind GFW: annual tree cover loss and gain, primary forest extent, GLAD/RADD deforestation alerts, fire alerts (VIIRS/MODIS), protected areas, concessions, Aqueduct water risk, carbon flux. Returns each dataset name (pass it to gfw_dataset or gfw_query), its title, tags and published versions. Keyless. AUTHORITATIVE for what forest-change data GFW actually publishes.

query.description: Optional keyword filter, matched against dataset name, title and tags (e.g. "tree cover loss", "fire", "peat").

page.description: Upstream page number, 1-based (default 1). Each upstream page holds up to 100 datasets.

tools.name: gfw_dataset
tools.description: Full detail for ONE Global Forest Watch dataset — metadata (source, citation, spatial resolution, geographic coverage, update frequency, cautions, licence) plus its version list. Pass a version (or "latest") to also get that version's status, assets and field/band list, which is what gfw_query needs to build a valid SQL statement. Keyless.

version.description: Optional version, e.g. "latest" or "v1.13". Omit for dataset-level metadata only.

tools.name: gfw_query
tools.description: Run a read-only SQL SELECT against one Global Forest Watch dataset version — e.g. tree cover loss hectares by year inside an area, or deforestation alerts inside a bounding box. The table is always called `data`; use gfw_dataset to see the available columns first. Almost every GFW dataset (tree cover loss/gain, GLAD/RADD alerts, fire alerts, carbon, primary forest) is a RASTER TILE SET, not a plain table — a `geometry` (GeoJSON Polygon/MultiPolygon) is REQUIRED to scope the pixels queried, or the API answers 422 "Raster tile set queries require a geometry". Omit it only for the few vector-table datasets (e.g. wdpa_protected_areas). Requires your own free GFW API key, passed as _apiKey.

sql.description: A SELECT statement over the table `data`, e.g. "SELECT umd_tree_cover_loss__year, SUM(area__ha) AS loss_ha FROM data WHERE umd_tree_cover_loss__year > 0 GROUP BY umd_tree_cover_loss__year". SELECT only; a LIMIT is appended if you omit one.

geometry.description: GeoJSON Polygon or MultiPolygon ({"type":"Polygon","coordinates":[...]}) scoping the query spatially. REQUIRED for raster tile set datasets — which is most of them; see gfw_dataset's version_assets. Example, a ~0.2° box over Rondônia, Brazil: {"type":"Polygon","coordinates":[[[-63.0,-9.0],[-62.8,-9.0],[-62.8,-8.8],[-63.0,-8.8],[-63.0,-9.0]]]}.

limit.description: Row cap appended when your SQL has no LIMIT (1-1000, default 100).

_apiKey.description: Your own Global Forest Watch API key (BYO). Get one free at globalforestwatch.org: create an account, then POST /auth/token followed by POST /auth/apikey on data-api.globalforestwatch.org to mint an x-api-key.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-global-forest-watch forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the global-forest-watch pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
